profile_text.body:
Tabnine is a software company that makes an AI code assistant aimed at enterprise development teams. The company describes its product as accelerating and simplifying software development while keeping code private, secure, and compliant. It offers deployment flexibility across cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments, and supports multiple models and IDEs.

The core of Tabnine's offering is its Enterprise Context Engine, which the company says learns an organization's architecture, frameworks, and coding standards rather than relying on generic training data. This context layer is designed to work across mixed stacks and legacy systems and to make AI suggestions conform to an organization's security, compliance, and performance requirements. The platform is also intended to expose that context to any agent or tool a team uses. Tabnine has been named a Visionary in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Code, according to the company's own site.

The site's held facts list Tabnine as a single tracked product in the coding and developer tools category, noted for code completion and a self-host option. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
